claim_limit: This is one released training trajectory. Variation across three disjoint evaluation blocks is not variation across training seeds, and checkpoint associations are descriptive until an intervention is run.
repeat_interpretation: The three blocks contain disjoint examples and are paired across checkpoints. Their sample standard deviation describes sensitivity to example sampling. It is not training-run uncertainty. Greedy generation uses one fixed seed because changing that seed does not change prefill states.
velocity_definition: Change in the replicate-specific depth-mean FDR divided by checkpoint-position change, only within trajectories with a shared unit and distinct positions.
